sentences.text:
Petitioner / Sole Accus
 Vs
 State rep. by:-
 The Sub-Inspector of Police,
 District Crime Branch, Erode,
 Erode District.

... Respondent/Complainant
 [Cr. No.Not known of 2025]

Prayer: - The Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 482
 B.N.S.S., praying to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner / Ac
 Crime No.Not known of 2025 on the file of the respondent police.

For Petitioner : Mr.Raj Kumar
 For Respondent : Mr.S.Santhosh
Government
Advocate
(Crl.Side)

Order 
The petitioner / Sole accused, who apprehends arrest at the hands of the respondent police for the offences punishable under Sections 316(2) and 318(2) of BNS (Section 406 and 420 IPC) in connection with the case in Crime No.Not known of 2025, seeks anticipatory bail.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 14/03/2025 02:47:55 pm )
2. The learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side) on instructions submitted that a petition enquiry is pending and an FIR has not been registered.
3. In view of the same, the respondent shall conduct and conclude the enquiry within a period of three weeks from today.
If the petitioner's appearance is required, the respondent shall issue a notice under Section 35 of BNSS, 2023 and on such notice, the petitioner shall appear before the respondent.
Till the conclusion of the enquiry, the respondent police shall not arrest the petitioner.
4. With the above directions, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
